name: robots/uthiras__scara_robot_ros2
title: Uthira SCARA/RRP robot simulation
intro: Uthira SCARA/RRP robot simulation, adapted from uthiras/scara_robot_ros2. It reads `read_joint_states` and `read_forward_kinematics_matrix`; runs `command_joint_efforts` and `forward_velocity_kinematics`. `command_joint_efforts`: publish one three-element joint effort command on the controller's command topic; the receipt confirms only that rosbridge accepted the publication and reports the efforts sent, not that a controller applied them, that the arm moved, or that it can stop. After an e-stop and reset the world stays paused, and a command sent then acts only when the operator unpauses it. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
